描述_EN: summer robe, probably that of a high military official; of blue silk gauze, embroidered with coloured silks and gold thread. flying bats and an occasional floral spray fill in the intervals. it is trimmed with silk and gold brocade of floral pattern. embroidered with four-clawed dragons pursuing flaming jewels in the midst of scrolled clouds having risen from sea-waves.
